name: MonarchAiContextWindowMeter
title: AiContextWindowMeter
wrapsNative: Segmented bar drawn with an HStack of Rectangles in a Capsule, MonarchChartLegend, MonarchInlineNotice, MonarchButton, and popover(isPresented:content:) with presentationCompactAdaptation(.popover) for the compact form
summary: How full the model's context window is: a segmented bar of what fills it with a legend, a notice as it nears the limit, and an optional Summarize earlier messages button.
whenToUse: In long conversations or with large attachments, so people understand why the assistant may leave out earlier messages, and when your service can summarize earlier messages to make room.
whenNotToUse: For quota or billing usage use MonarchAiUsageMeter. To list what the assistant can see use MonarchAiContextChips.
api: MonarchAiContextWindowMeter.init(used: Int, limit: Int, breakdown: [MonarchAiContextWindowPart] = [], warningAt: Double = 0.8, isApproximate: Bool = false, isSummarizing: Bool = false, labels: MonarchAiContextWindowMeterLabels = MonarchAiContextWindowMeterLabels(), isCompact: Bool = false, onSummarize: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil)

MonarchAiContextWindowMeter.init(usage: MonarchAiUsage, limit: Int, breakdown: [MonarchAiContextWindowPart] = [], warningAt: Double = 0.8, isApproximate: Bool = false, isSummarizing: Bool = false, labels: MonarchAiContextWindowMeterLabels = MonarchAiContextWindowMeterLabels(), isCompact: Bool = false, onSummarize: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil)
MonarchAiContextWindowPart.init(_ label: String, id: String? = nil, tokens: Int)
enum MonarchAiContextWindowState { case ok, warning, full; static func of(used: Int, limit: Int, warningAt: Double = 0.8) -> MonarchAiContextWindowState }

MonarchAiContextWindowMeterLabels.init(label: String? = nil, amount: (@Sendable (_ used: String, _ limit: String, _ percent: String) -> String)? = nil, approximate: (@Sendable (_ amount: String) -> String)? = nil, legend: String? = nil, other: String? = nil, tokens: (@Sendable (_ formatted: String) -> String)? = nil, warning: String? = nil, full: String? = nil, summarize: String? = nil, showDetails: String? = nil)

options.name: used
options.description: The tokens in the context window now.

options.name: usage
options.description: The usage the latest reply reported in the conversation model; input plus output tokens are used.

options.name: limit
options.description: The model's context window size, in tokens.

options.name: breakdown
options.description: What the tokens are made of, drawn as coloured segments with a legend. Uncovered tokens are shown as Other.

options.name: warningAt
options.description: The share of the limit at which the meter warns.

options.name: isApproximate
options.description: The count is an estimate: the summary reads "About …".

options.name: isSummarizing
options.description: A summary is being made: the button shows progress and does nothing.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replaces every built-in string and the summary format.

options.name: isCompact
options.description: A small bar and the percentage, for a toolbar; activating it opens the full meter in a popover.

states.name: ok
states.description: Below warningAt: no notice; the single fill is the accent and the summarize button is a ghost button.

states.name: warning
states.description: At or above warningAt: a warning notice with an icon; the single fill is warning and the button is secondary.

states.name: full
states.description: At or over the limit: a danger notice saying earlier messages are being left out; the single fill is danger.

states.name: approximate
states.description: The summary and the spoken value start with "About".

states.name: summarizing
states.description: The button shows a spinner, reads "Loading" as its value and ignores taps.

states.name: compact
states.description: Bar, percentage and, when warning or full, a tone icon, as one button that opens the details in a popover.

appearance: A muted track with segments in the theme's data colours (the sixth part and Other in the subtle text colour), a label in default text and the summary in muted text. Without a breakdown the fill is accent, warning or danger solid. The high-contrast themes resolve the same roles to stronger colours.
platformNotes: The web cycles the five data colours for a sixth part; iOS follows MonarchChartLegend and draws the sixth part and later in neutral. The web's useAiContextUsage hook and its token estimator are not offered: pass used and isApproximate, or the usage the latest message reported. The compact form opens the details in a popover instead of hiding them. Android uses the same names.
accessibility: The bar is one element named "Context window" whose value is the summary, for example "45,000 of 128,000 tokens (35%)", with the updates-frequently trait.
The legend is a container named "What fills the context window"; each entry is read as its label and amount, and the swatches are decorative.
The notice is written text with an icon, so the state does not depend on colour, and VoiceOver announces it when the state changes while the meter is on screen.
The compact meter is a button with the same name and value, a hint that it shows the details, and a 44-point touch target.
edgeCases: Negative counts are drawn as zero; a limit of zero or less is always ok and shows 0%.
When the parts add up to more than the window, the bar is scaled to the total so every part stays visible.
Parts that cover more than used produce no Other entry.
The heading and summary sit on one line when they fit and stack at large text sizes.

examples.title: With a breakdown
examples.template:
MonarchAiContextWindowMeter(
    used: {{used}},
    limit: {{limit}},
    breakdown: [
        MonarchAiContextWindowPart({{breakdown.0.label}}, tokens: {{breakdown.0.tokens}}),
        MonarchAiContextWindowPart({{breakdown.1.label}}, tokens: {{breakdown.1.tokens}}),
        MonarchAiContextWindowPart({{breakdown.2.label}}, tokens: {{breakdown.2.tokens}}),
    ]
)
.frame(maxWidth: 384)
examples.code:
MonarchAiContextWindowMeter(
    used: 46_000,
    limit: 128_000,
    breakdown: [
        MonarchAiContextWindowPart("Instructions", tokens: 3000),
        MonarchAiContextWindowPart("Attachments", tokens: 18_000),
        MonarchAiContextWindowPart("Messages", tokens: 22_000),
    ]
)
.frame(maxWidth: 384)

examples.title: Compact, from the reported usage
examples.code:
MonarchAiContextWindowMeter(
    usage: MonarchAiUsage(inputTokens: 100_000, outputTokens: 4_000),
    limit: 128_000,
    isCompact: true
)
